transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I wanted to convene this group to discuss the royalty reporting situation with our reseller partner. As you may know, the reseller agreement requires quarterly royalty reports, and we have audit rights under that agreement. For the last two quarters, the reseller has reported lower royalties than our sales team expected. With the agreement coming up for renewal in 45 days, we need to decide how to approach this. Before I approve any response, I'd like to follow our routine cross-functional review process. So I'm asking commercial finance and strategic accounts counsel to share any relevant information they have that might help us understand what's going on. Does anyone have insights they'd like to start with?
